test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**

The Greeks are considered to be a courageous race valuing the knowledge, beauty and wisidiom.
solution: The correct answer is **"Wisidiom."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is** 'wisdom' **with an **'o' **instead of** 'i'.** • **'Wisidiom'** is not a recognized word in the English language. • **"Wisdom"** means the ability to make sensible decisions and judgements because of your knowledge or experience. ((ज्ञान या अनुभव के आधार पर) विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने की क्षमता, समझदारी, बुद्धिमानी, अक़लमंदी) • **Example**: *I don’t see the **wisdom**__ of this plan.* • The correct sentence would be* "The Greeks are considered to be a courageous race valuing knowledge, beauty, and wisdom."* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2: 'Knowledge' **is correctly spelled. It means knowledge (of about something) information, understanding and skills that you have gained through learning or experience. (शिक्षा या अनुभव से प्राप्‍त जानकारी, समझ और कौशल) • **Option 3: 'Valuing'** is correctly spelled. It means to think somebody/something is very important. (किसी व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को महत्वपूर्ण या मूल्‍यवान मानना) • **Option 4: 'Courageous'** is correctly spelled. It means not deterred by danger or pain; brave. (साहसी, हिम्‍मती) 3f:Tb80, The correct answer is **"Jurisprudence."**
